title: INSIGHT: A Universal Neural Simulator Framework for Analog Circuits with Autoregressive Transformers
problem: SPICE simulation is computationally expensive and slow, hindering automated analog circuit design and optimization. Neural surrogate models exist but often lack data efficiency, cross-technology generalization, or high fidelity.
motivation: Accelerating analog design automation requires fast, accurate performance prediction; SPICE simulation is the bottleneck for circuit sizing and optimization.
method: INSIGHT formulates analog performance prediction as autoregressive sequence generation using transformers. The framework is data-efficient, adaptive, high-fidelity, and technology-agnostic. Cross-technology transfer learning with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) preserves performance with 60% less training data and reduces memory/training time by 42% and 25% respectively.
key_novelty: Autoregressive transformer-based neural simulator for technology-agnostic analog performance prediction with efficient cross-technology transfer via LoRA.
contributions: INSIGHT neural simulator achieving R^2 >= 0.95 outperforming existing surrogates
Cross-technology transfer learning with 60% data reduction and 42% memory reduction
RL-based circuit sizing 100-1000x faster than existing methods

metrics.speedup: 100-1000x faster circuit sizing vs. existing methods

primary_theme: transformer-based neural simulator for analog design
